subject: Request: honorarium + trial extension for SignalFlow maintainers
messages:
From: Alexis Rivera <alexis@signalflow.dev>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: HackSeries Org <hackseries-org@events.org>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: honorarium + trial extension for SignalFlow maintainers

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well — I’m Alexis, one of the lead maintainers for SignalFlow (an open-source observability library focused on ML pipelines). We’re running a month-long hack series called "HackSeries: Observability + ML" the week of Nov 15 and are coordinating a small honorarium and platform credits for the 6 maintainers who will be mentoring projects.

What we’re asking for:
- Developer credits for the maintainers to run lightweight inference/embeddings for demos (rough estimate: 60k token-equivalent credits split across team).
- A 90-day trial extension for two maintainers to test Redwood Dedicated for heavier demos.
- A modest honorarium (we planned for $2,000) to cover travel/stipends and thank-yous.

Attached: grant-policy.pdf, maintainers-list.csv, and a short one‑pager about the event.

We’re an early-stage OSS project but the event will drive adoption in the observability community; we’d be happy to surface Redwood as a platform sponsor in the event page and in our recap blog.

Can you let me know what information you need to evaluate this?

Thanks — Alexis
Alexis Rivera
Maintainer, SignalFlow
https://signalflow.dev

--

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alexis Rivera <alexis@signalflow.dev>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: honorarium + trial extension for SignalFlow maintainers

Hi Alexis — really appreciate the clear ask and materials. A few quick clarifying questions so I can route to the right internal teams:

1) Can you confirm the dates when maintainers need Dedicated access (start/end)?
2) Approx expected QPS / tokens per minute for demos (ballpark is fine).
3) Are any demos processing sensitive customer data or PII?
4) Are the maintainers individuals or an entity (for payment)? If individuals, we’ll need vendor info (W-9 or equivalent).
5) Would SignalFlow be open to a short case study / quote in return for credits/honorarium?

I’ll loop in our sales and partnerships folks once I have these details. If all looks normal, we typically propose a credits + short trial package plus a small stipend.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Developer Relations, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

(no attachments)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:26:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request from SignalFlow - recommend credit package?

Looping you in on SignalFlow — quick read: open-source maintainers, small hack series Nov 15, asking for 60k credits + 90d Dedicated trials + $2k honorarium. Attachments in Alexis' original.

My recommendation (to move quickly):
- Approve a community package: 40k dev-credits (token-equivalent), 2 extended Dedicated trials (90 days) for maintainers to demo heavier use cases, and a $1,500 community stipend.
- Require: public acknowledgement of Redwood on event page + permission to publish a short blurb/case study after the event.
- Finance/legal: process stipend as vendor payment after W-9 is provided.

If Sales wants to stretch credits higher in exchange for an intro to their enterprise team, we can consider. I’m fine approving the package above under a community grants budget.

Relevant: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/SignalFlow (I created a company record). Deal id candidate: SF-GRANT-2026-4729.

Thanks — Lauren
VP, Developer Experience

--
(no attachments)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request from SignalFlow - recommend credit package?

Thanks for the summary Lauren — happy to support but two small asks:
1) Reduce stipend to $1,500 (we can do $2k only for larger programs).
2) Make the Dedicated trial seats 2 and cap trial compute at a preset burst cap to protect against runaway spend.

Also recommend a 90-day trial window, 40k credits, and a requirement they display Redwood branding + include a 30-day usage review where Sales gets an intro to any teams that show enterprise traction.

If legal agrees on simple terms (attach a short MOU), I say go ahead. I’ll loop marketing if they’re willing to amplify.

—Priyom
Enterprise Sales

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alexis Rivera <alexis@signalflow.dev>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, HackSeries Org <hackseries-org@events.org>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Redwood community package for SignalFlow (next steps)

Hi Alexis — great to connect. Thanks for the materials and for answering my questions over the weekend. Quick summary of what we can provide for HackSeries: 

1) Credits: 40,000 token-equivalent developer credits, delivered as a one-time promotional credit applied to the SignalFlow account.
2) Trials: 2 Extended Dedicated trial seats (90 days) for heavier demos. Trials will be provisioned in our US region and include a soft compute cap to prevent unexpected spend.
3) Honorarium: $1,500 community stipend to be paid to the maintainer entity. We’ll need vendor details (W-9 or equivalent) to process payment.

Conditions:
- Public acknowledgment of Redwood on the event page / workshop materials.
- Permission to run a short case study or quote post-event.
- Redwood reserves the right to pause trials if usage is outside the agreed scope.

Next steps:
- Please share: (a) vendor/payment details, (b) names/emails for the two maintainers who need Dedicated seats, (c) exact demo dates.
- I’ll open the HubSpot deal (SF-GRANT-2026-4729) and attach a short MOU. I’ll also send a DocuSign acceptance link for the organizer to sign.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded/ABC-123-approve
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/SignalFlow

If that all looks good, we’ll provision credits and trial seats within 48 hours of receiving vendor details and maintainer names.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Developer Relations, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
